description: This file defines cultural and localization information for Norwegian (Nynorsk) ('nn-NO') in the DateJS library, including date formats, day and month names, and timezone data.

classes.name: Date.CultureInfo
classes.description: Object containing cultural information for Norwegian Nynorsk locale.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Sets hours, minutes, seconds, and milliseconds of the date to zero.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the time of the date object to the current time.
